Peanut Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 20, 2009 - 12:12am

Ingredients




4 boneless skinless chicken-breast halves
1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
1/2 cup honey
1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper
1/2 cup chopped peanuts

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degress. Place chicken breasts in a 9- by 13-inch baking dish. 2 In a medium bowl, combine peanut butter, honey, and pepper; mix well and spread over chicken. Top with peanuts and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until no pink remains in chicken. 3 Serve topped with sauce from the baking dish. 4 This recipe yields 4 servings.
